quizzes.question_text: What is the surface area?\n___ square centimetres
quizzes.backend_description: This image shows a cube with each side labeled as 14 centimetres.
solution_image_tag: This image shows a square with sides measuring 5 cm.
solution: Each face of the cube is a square with sides that are 14 centimetres long.
Find the area of one face:
Area = side $\times$ side\n$= 14 \times 14$\n$= 196$
The area of each face is 196 square centimetres. There are 6 faces.
Multiply:\nSurface Area = $6 \times 196 = 1176$
The surface area of the cube is 1176 square centimetres.
